
# Figure: Method Performance Heatmap

```{r heatmap-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

heatmap_data <- all_results %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    power = mean(selected[variable %in% true_vars]),
    null_selection = mean(selected[variable %in% null_vars]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(power, null_selection),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = dplyr::recode(
      metric,
      power = "Power",
      null_selection = "Null Predictor Selection"
    ),
    rho = factor(rho),
    n = factor(n),
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward p-value",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO lambda.1se",
        "LASSO lambda.min",
        "Elastic Net lambda.1se",
        "Elastic Net lambda.min"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Backward",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO 1se",
        "LASSO min",
        "EN 1se",
        "EN min"
      )
    )
  )

heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = method, y = rho, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ n) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Variable Selection Performance Across Sample Size and Predictor Correlation",
    subtitle = "Power for true predictors and selection frequency of null predictors",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Correlation (rho)",
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

heatmap_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_fig, "Figure1_Heatmap_Performance.png"),
  plot = heatmap_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6
)
```

**Figure:** Heatmap showing power and false positive rates for each method across sample sizes and correlation levels. Darker colors indicate higher values.

```{r figure2-power-variable, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Figure 2: Power by Variable (X1-X5)


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

power_variable_data <- all_results %>%
  filter(variable %in% true_vars) %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method, variable) %>%
  summarize(
    power = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = factor(rho),
    n = factor(n),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = true_vars),
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward p-value",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO lambda.min",
        "LASSO lambda.1se",
        "Elastic Net lambda.min",
        "Elastic Net lambda.1se"
      )
    )
  )

power_plot <- ggplot(
  power_variable_data,
  aes(x = variable, y = power, color = method, group = method)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(rho ~ n) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Variable-level power across sample size and predictor correlation",
    x = "True Predictor",
    y = "Power (True Positive Rate)",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

power_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_fig, "Figure2_Power_By_Variable.png"),
  plot = power_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

```






```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Figure 3: Bias by Variable (X1-X5)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

bias_variable_data <- all_results %>%
  filter(variable %in% true_vars) %>%
  group_by(n, rho, method, variable) %>%
  summarize(
    bias = mean(bias_uncond, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = factor(rho),
    n = factor(n),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = true_vars),
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward p-value",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO lambda.min",
        "LASSO lambda.1se",
        "Elastic Net lambda.min",
        "Elastic Net lambda.1se"
      )
    )
  )

bias_plot <- ggplot(
  bias_variable_data,
  aes(x = variable, y = bias, color = method, group = method)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(rho ~ n) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3. Variable-level unconditional bias across sample size and predictor correlation",
    x = "True Predictor",
    y = "Unconditional Bias",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

bias_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_fig, "Figure3_Bias_By_Variable.png"),
  plot = bias_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)
```
